field_contracts.chart_spec: chart specs declare chart id, chart type, generic series, dimensions, theme, source metadata, and stale-data warning
field_contracts.recipe_matrix: recipe matrix maps generic chart families to deterministic spec hashes without domain-specific metrics
field_contracts.render_request: render requests name renderer, output format, dimensions, theme, and chart spec ref without importing renderer dependencies
field_contracts.render_result: render results carry artifact metadata, deterministic snapshot hash, warnings, source metadata, and clean-skip status
field_contracts.source_metadata: source metadata declares provider-free fixture key, captured/as-of timestamps, redacted source locator, stale policy, and replay readiness
field_contracts.unsupported_renderer: unsupported renderer requests clean-skip without importing renderer, browser, or network dependencies
